title: Scramble Link Button | Community Components | 21st
author: hyperiux (Hyperiux Vault)
note: Prompt captured with Change copy action > Claude Code (tab viewport 1280x800, clipboard writeText hooked in the page, nothing reached the system clipboard). 8,547 characters / 8,547 bytes (pure ASCII). The page's SHA-256 of the captured string equals the SHA-256 of the saved file byte for byte, no normalization. Text moved out of the page as a JSON-escaped string, so blank lines are exact. Info tab: Dependencies lucide-react (already in the app); Tags Button, Link, Text Animation, Underline, Scramble; License MIT License; Published 9/2/2026. Renders a real <a href> whose label scrambles into a-z0-9 glyphs on mouse enter (and on tap below 1025px) then resolves; the scrambling span carries aria-label with the real label; prefers-reduced-motion skips the scramble and the underline/arrow transitions. Defaults to watch: hoverColor #ff6b00 (set it to the theme's primary) and a vw-based font size (text-[1.1vw], max-lg 3vw, max-md 4.2vw) that the app should override with className.
